description: Remaining VTT mappers: Foundry dnd5e, Foundry pf2e, Roll20, Generic VTT, plus the Roll20/Generic two-call game-system-selection handshake integration test. Depends on FEAT-001 (abstraction, endpoint, detector, DI pattern). Independent of FEAT-003 (DDB) and FEAT-004 (frontend).
steps: Read context.json and the design note sections 'Task 4', 'Task 5', 'Task 6', 'Task 7', 'Ruleset detection', and the endpoint 'Second-call handshake rules'. Follow the FEAT-001 mapper + DI + test patterns already in the tree.

Create src/backend/Aircane.Application/Characters/Import/DndBeyondSources.cs if not already present (static readonly HashSet<int> Ruleset2024SourceIds = {672,673,674}) — Foundry ruleset detection does not need it but DDB (FEAT-003) does; create here only if convenient, otherwise FEAT-003 owns it. Prefer leaving DDB-specific files to FEAT-003.

Create src/backend/Aircane.Application/Characters/Import/FoundryDnd5eMapper.cs (Source=FoundryDnd5e, Order=0). Detection: root.type=='character' AND root.system has 'abilities' AND system.attributes.hp exists AND NOT pf2e (system.details.ancestry absent). Map name->Identity.Name; system.details.race->Identity.RaceOrAncestry (subtype->ExtraFields 'Subrace'); system.details.background->Identity.Background; level = system.details.level or sum(items[type=class].system.levels)->Classes[0].Level; items[type=class].name->Classes[0].ClassName; items[type=subclass].name->Classes[0].Subclass; system.abilities.*.value->Abilities.*; system.attributes.hp.value/max/temp->Combat.CurrentHitPoints/MaxHitPoints/TemporaryHitPoints; system.attributes.ac.value->Combat.ArmorClass; system.attributes.movement.walk->Combat.Speed. items[spell|feat|weapon|equipment|tool|consumable|loot] and system.skills.{key}.total -> ExtraFields. Forced 'dnd-5e-2014'. DetectRuleset(JsonElement): primary root._stats.systemVersion (Version.TryParse >=3.0.0->'2024' else '2014'); fallback system.details.source.book referencing a known 2024 publication; default '2014' + RulesetRequiresConfirmation=true when systemVersion absent. Confidence High. Numeric MappedFields values are bare base-10 integer strings; omit any path the fixture did not provide.

Create src/backend/Aircane.Application/Characters/Import/FoundryPf2eMapper.cs (Source=FoundryPf2e, Order=0). Detection: root.type=='character' AND system.details.ancestry present. Map name->Identity.Name; system.details.ancestry.name->Identity.RaceOrAncestry (heritage.name->ExtraFields 'Heritage'); system.details.background.name->Identity.Background; system.details.level.value->Classes[0].Level; system.details.class.name->Classes[0].ClassName; system.abilities.*.value (modifiers)->Abilities.*; system.attributes.hp.value/max->Combat.CurrentHitPoints/MaxHitPoints; system.attributes.ac.value->Combat.ArmorClass; system.attributes.speed.value->Combat.Speed. classDC, saves.fortitude/reflex/will, items[action|feat|spell|weapon|armor|equipment]->ExtraFields. Forced 'pathfinder-2e-remaster'/'Remaster', Confidence High.

Create src/backend/Aircane.Application/Characters/Import/Roll20Mapper.cs (Source=Roll20, Order=0). Detection: root has 'schema_version' AND root.character has 'attribs'. attribs is a flat array of {name,current,max}. Map by attrib name (D&D 5e Roll20 sheet): character_name->Identity.Name; race->Identity.RaceOrAncestry; class->Classes[0].ClassName; level->Classes[0].Level; strength/dexterity/constitution/intelligence/wisdom/charisma->Abilities.*; hp->Combat.CurrentHitPoints; hp_max->Combat.MaxHitPoints; ac->Combat.ArmorClass; speed->Combat.Speed. Every mapped path is ALSO added to RequiresReviewPaths; a missing attrib leaves the default and is omitted from MappedFields. ALWAYS Confidence=Low. GameSystemIdentifier=null (triggers the handshake).

Create src/backend/Aircane.Application/Characters/Import/GenericVttMapper.cs (Source=GenericVtt, Order=int.MaxValue). Heuristic name fields (name/character_name/charname/Name) and ability-score paths (str/strength/STR/abilities.str/stats.str...). CanMap true if any name OR ability heuristic matches. Everything mapped goes into RequiresReviewPaths; Confidence=Low; add warning 'We couldn't identify this character sheet format. Please review and correct all fields before saving.'. GameSystemIdentifier=null.

MODIFY src/backend/Aircane.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs: register FoundryDnd5eMapper, FoundryPf2eMapper, Roll20Mapper, GenericVttMapper as ICharacterSourceMapper (Order governs precedence; registration order irrelevant).

Add unit tests under tests/backend/Aircane.UnitTests/Characters/Import/: FoundryDnd5eMapperTests (detection; _stats.systemVersion ruleset v3+->2024 / v2->2014 / absent->2014+RulesetRequiresConfirmation; class/subclass from items; sums class levels; HP/AC/speed; no phantom defaults), FoundryPf2eMapperTests (ancestry detection; modifier mapping; forced PF2e; FoundryDnd5e detection does NOT match a pf2e doc — negative), Roll20MapperTests (flat attrib mapping; missing attrib omitted + review; always Low; no forced system), GenericVttMapperTests (name/ability heuristics; all-fields review; Low; warning text). Add fixtures foundry-dnd5e.json, foundry-pf2e.json, roll20.json, generic-vtt.json (anonymised, name 'Test Character', no PII). Extend CharacterFormatDetectorTests so Generic loses to every specific mapper and FoundryPf2e vs FoundryDnd5e are mutually exclusive.

Extend tests/backend/Aircane.IntegrationTests/CharacterSourceImportIntegrationTests.cs: POST the Foundry dnd5e fixture (no source) -> 200 with draft + review.gameSystemDefinitionId. Roll20 two-call handshake (MEDIUM-4): POST the Roll20 fixture with NO source/gameSystemDefinitionId -> assert review.requiresGameSystemSelection=true, requiresSourceConfirmation=true, and NO character row persisted; then re-POST the SAME body with BOTH ?source=Roll20 AND a valid gameSystemDefinitionId -> assert detection pinned (DetectedSource=Roll20), a draft IS persisted, review.requiresGameSystemSelection=false and review.mappedFields returned.
Run the backend build and both backend test suites from the worktree; fix failures; commit locally on the branch (no push).
acceptance_criteria: dotnet test tests/backend/Aircane.UnitTests/Aircane.UnitTests.csproj passes, including the four new mapper test classes and the extended detector tests.

dotnet test tests/backend/Aircane.IntegrationTests/Aircane.IntegrationTests.csproj passes, including the Foundry dnd5e happy path and the Roll20 two-call handshake (no-persist first call, pinned-source persisted second call).
findings:
IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED (build 0 errors; UnitTests 2043 pass incl. 70 in Characters.Import; IntegrationTests 89 pass). FEAT-001 tests still green (no regression).

NEW MAPPERS (all namespace Aircane.Application.Characters.Import, each ICharacterSourceMapper, never-throwing, follow the PathbuilderTwoMapper pattern — TryGetProperty + ValueKind guards, numeric MappedFields as bare base-10 integer strings, omit any path the source did not provide):
- FoundryDnd5eMapper (Source=FoundryDnd5e, Order=0). CanMap: root.type=='character' AND system.abilities present AND system.attributes.hp exists AND system.details.ancestry ABSENT (pf2e exclusion). Maps name/race(+subtype->ExtraFields 'Subrace')/background; class+subclass from items[type=class|subclass].name; level = system.details.level ELSE sum(items[type=class].system.levels); system.abilities.*.value; hp.value/max/temp; ac.value; movement.walk. items[spell|feat|weapon|equipment|tool|consumable|loot] names + system.skills.{18 keys}.total -> ExtraFields. Forced 'dnd-5e-2014', Confidence High. DetectRuleset: primary root._stats.systemVersion (Version.TryParse >=3.0.0 -> '2024' else '2014', no confirmation); fallback system.details.source.book contains a 2024 marker -> '2024'; neither signal -> '2014' + RulesetRequiresConfirmation=true.
- FoundryPf2eMapper (Source=FoundryPf2e, Order=0). CanMap: root.type=='character' AND system.details.ancestry present. Maps name; ancestry.name (heritage.name->ExtraFields 'Heritage'); background.name; class.name; level.value; system.abilities.*.value (PF2e MODIFIERS copied verbatim, can be negative); hp.value/max; ac.value; speed.value. classDC + saves.fortitude/reflex/will (object{value} or bare number) + items[action|feat|spell|weapon|armor|equipment] -> ExtraFields. Forced 'pathfinder-2e-remaster'/'Remaster', Confidence High.
- Roll20Mapper (Source=Roll20, Order=0). CanMap: root.schema_version present AND root.character.attribs is an array. attribs flattened (first-wins, case-insensitive) into name->current lookup; maps character_name/race/class/level/str..cha (full ability names: strength..charisma)/hp/hp_max/ac/speed. EVERY mapped path also added to RequiresReviewPaths; a missing attrib is omitted. ALWAYS Confidence=Low, GameSystemIdentifier=null (triggers the handshake), Ruleset=null.
- GenericVttMapper (Source=GenericVtt, Order=int.MaxValue). CanMap true if a name heuristic (name/character_name/charname/Name, case-insensitive) OR any ability heuristic (str/strength etc. at top level or nested under abilities/stats/attributes/scores, value may be number, numeric string, or object{value|score|current}) matches. Everything mapped goes into RequiresReviewPaths; Confidence=Low; GameSystemIdentifier=null; Warnings=["We couldn't identify this character sheet format. Please review and correct all fields before saving."].

DI: added AddScoped<ICharacterSourceMapper, {FoundryDnd5eMapper,FoundryPf2eMapper,Roll20Mapper,GenericVttMapper}>() alongside PathbuilderTwoMapper in Aircane.Infrastructure.DependencyInjection (registration order irrelevant; CharacterFormatDetector orders by Order). The controller (FEAT-001) ALREADY routes these: ForcedIdentifier maps FoundryPf2e->pathfinder-2e-remaster, FoundryDnd5e->dnd-5e-2014, Roll20/GenericVtt->null (handshake). NO controller change was needed for FEAT-002.

DndBeyondSources.cs was NOT created here (step 2 said prefer leaving DDB-specific files to FEAT-003; Foundry ruleset detection uses _stats.systemVersion, not sourceIds). FEAT-003 owns DndBeyondSources, DndBeyondApiMapper, DndBeyondCompanionMapper, the dndbeyond-url endpoint, DndBeyondUrlImportService, DndBeyondPdfHints + the PdfCharacterExtractor override, and WireMock.Net.

TESTS: tests/backend/Aircane.UnitTests/Characters/Import/{FoundryDnd5eMapperTests,FoundryPf2eMapperTests,Roll20MapperTests,GenericVttMapperTests}.cs (70 Import tests total incl. FEAT-001). CharacterFormatDetectorTests extended: AllMappersDetector() (shuffled, Generic first) + [Theory] proving each specific fixture wins over Generic, FoundryDnd5e vs FoundryPf2e mutual exclusivity, and generic-vtt.json falling back to Generic. New fixtures Characters/Import/Fixtures/{foundry-dnd5e,foundry-pf2e,roll20,generic-vtt}.json (name 'Test Character', no PII) — picked up by the existing Fixtures\**\*.json CopyToOutputDirectory glob, no csproj edit needed. Integration: CharacterSourceImportIntegrationTests extended with Import_DetectsFoundryDnd5e_AndReturnsReviewWithGameSystem and Import_Roll20_TwoCallHandshake_FirstCallDoesNotPersist_SecondCallDoes (first call asserts requiresGameSystemSelection=true + Characters row count unchanged; second call pins ?source=Roll20 + gameSystemDefinitionId=10000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 and asserts DetectedSource=Roll20, requiresGameSystemSelection=false, mappedFields present, +1 persisted). Count via AircaneDbContext.Characters.CountAsync() in a service scope.
